automatic_events: Do not manually duplicate first_open/ad_impression/in_app_purchase supplied by SDK integrations. Canonical revenue uses one deduplicated projection.

metrics.name: crash_free_users
metrics.formula: 1 - unique active users with fatal crash / unique active users in identical seven-day build window
metrics.action: Release severity gate; sparse cohorts use absolute defect review.

metrics.name: save_corruption
metrics.formula: known reproducible corruption or unrecoverable loss defects
metrics.action: Any reproducible loss blocks release; incidence is not permission to lose a few saves.

metrics.name: verified_purchase_grant_failures
metrics.formula: durably verified purchases not granted after recovery/retry, excluding genuinely pending store payments
metrics.action: Any known broken grant path blocks release.

metrics.name: earned_reward_grant_failure_rate
metrics.formula: unique earned receipts not durably granted after safe recovery / unique earned receipts
metrics.action: Alert threshold only; known duplicate/lost reward defect still blocks.

metrics.name: first_battle_start_rate
metrics.formula: first-install players starting their first battle / eligible first opens in same measurable cohort

metrics.name: tutorial_completion
metrics.formula: players completing or explicitly skipping all tutorial prompts / players shown first tutorial prompt
metrics.action: Report skip separately; no fake tutorial completion.

metrics.name: first_expedition_completion
metrics.formula: players winning their first expedition attempt / players starting first expedition attempt
metrics.action: Distinguish losses, exits and unresolved resumable attempts; censor latter until window closes.

metrics.name: D1_active_retention
metrics.formula: installs with foreground gameplay >=10s in [24h,48h) after first open / measurable installs aged>=48h
metrics.action: Internal investigation target, not external benchmark.

metrics.name: D7_active_retention
metrics.formula: installs with foreground gameplay >=10s in [168h,192h) / measurable installs aged>=192h
metrics.action: Not first-release gate; report confidence interval and missing consent.

metrics.name: D30_active_retention
metrics.formula: installs with foreground gameplay >=10s in [720h,744h) / measurable installs aged>=744h
metrics.action: Not first-release gate; mature cohort only.

query_rules: exclude test/build environments and test receipts; report denominators and Wilson95% intervals; consent-related missingness explicit; source/country/build cohort separation; no causal conclusions from selection-win correlation
revenue: ads callback estimates separate from reconciled earnings; net IAP receipts after real reports, not hardcoded fee; one-time buyers not recurring revenue
organic: five approved genuine gameplay clip concepts; source-tagged links; no fake reviews/spam; unattributed remains unattributed
cadence: Developer inspects health after test/release; weekly gameplay/organic review; monthly financial close. No background task or alert subscription created by this document.
health_metric_separation: Crashlytics crash-free users, Play user-perceived crashes and Play ANRs are different denominators; do not transform one into another.

additional_health_targets.rate_windows: same documented build/time window; always show denominator and source; known severe defects block independent of sample

query_contract: reports/sql contains BigQuery-ready parameterized templates over a defined normalized event view; deployment identifiers are explicit inputs, not fake deployed resources.
